description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'patience' diff algorithm, involving setup of test cases, execution of 'git diff' with specific options, and verification of output.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test case expecting success with specified command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_diff_frobnitz
methods.description: Runs a custom diff test with 'frobnitz' nomenclature, likely a special test case.

methods.name: test_diff_unique
methods.description: Runs a diff test checking for unique output or behavior.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite.
